name: ShowOps Agent
author: ShowOps
description: Connects this FPP player to your ShowOps account at api.showops.io for monitoring and remote management. On instruction from ShowOps the agent can set FPP's restart banner, upgrade FPP or the OS, change volume, skip playlist items, change playlists and schedules, and open a remote support session through a Cloudflare Tunnel to this player's FPP web UI (cloudflared is fetched from github.com and pinned). Diagnostics, map location, configuration backup and restore (passwords removed), and the reboot banner stay off until you turn them on in the plugin page. The agent is closed source and does not replace its own binary. Pair only on a trusted network. Raspberry Pi and BeagleBone (ARM) only.

privacy.summary: ShowOps watches this player and alerts you when the show does not start. Song, playlist, position, and volume go to your ShowOps account only while that player's page is open. Playback changes, and a private connection to this player's FPP pages, happen only when you ask. Diagnostics, location, backups, and the reboot banner stay off until you turn them on here.

sends.what: hostname, FPP, OS and agent version, board, playback, next show time, CPU, memory and disk use
sends.why: to show this player's status in your ShowOps account

sends.what: hostname and a hash of this player's machine id and MAC addresses (a hardware identifier)
sends.why: to recognize this player when you pair it

sends.what: song, playlist, position and volume while someone has this player's live page open in ShowOps
sends.why: to show the live page in your ShowOps account
to place the show on a map when you enable location

sends.what: installed plugins, network details, FPP system status and logs
sends.why: to troubleshoot this player when you enable diagnostics

sends.what: a configuration backup with passwords removed
sends.why: to restore this player when you enable backups

sends.what: this player's FPP web pages during a remote support session
sends.why: so the helper signed in to ShowOps can open FPP remotely

systemChanges.what: Installs and enables the fpp-monitor-agent systemd service, run as the fpp user
Install and Update fetch the closed-source agent from api.showops.io, SHA-256 checked against the checksums committed in this plugin
For remote support the agent fetches pinned cloudflared 2024.8.3 from github.com
Remote support can open a Cloudflare Tunnel to this player's web UI
On request sets FPP's restart and reboot banners, upgrades FPP or the OS, changes volume, skips playlist items, and edits playlists and schedules
Restores a ShowOps configuration backup onto this player, only when backups are turned on
Backup reads FPP settings and blanks password, token, key, secret and pass fields before upload
Probes LAN hosts and ports only if listed in network_allowlist, which is empty by default
Restarts the ShowOps service with FPP's sudo helper

privacy.other: Pair only on a trusted network. Pairing credentials stay in plugindata until Unpair. The agent does not replace its own binary; Update in Plugin Manager installs new agents. ShowOps can ask FPP to upgrade this plugin through FPP's own plugin upgrade. Remote support is signed in through ShowOps, opened from the cloud, and idle-limited. cloudflared stays on the pinned 2024.8.3 build. A remote session reaches only this player's FPP web UI. ShowOps can turn a listed capability off and cannot turn a switch on.
